settings_tab.title: Global Settings

settings_tab.launch_args_desc: Append to default CDP arguments when starting Codex App. Keep empty for default startup behavior.

overview.sponsor_desc: Codex++ official relay station, featuring stable access and cost-effective prices. Supports GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, gpt-image-2 and other models/image capabilities.
overview.health_desc: Overview only shows critical issues. Detailed configurations are handled on respective pages.
overview.codex_app_detail: Codex App path has not been checked.
overview.silent_entry_detail: Missing Codex++ silent shortcut, can be repaired on maintenance page.
overview.manager_entry_detail: Missing manager tool shortcut, can be repaired on maintenance page.

relay.list_detail: {{count}} provider configurations; drag to sort, click edit to view details
relay.enable_switch_desc: When disabled, this tool will not write to Codex's config.toml / auth.json during manual switching; it will never automatically modify these files when starting Codex.
relay.model_placeholder: Written to the model field in config.toml, e.g., gpt-5
relay.context_window_placeholder: Leave blank to not modify, e.g., 200000
relay.auto_compact_placeholder: Leave blank to not modify, e.g., 160000
relay.model_list_placeholder: One model per line, e.g., qwen3-coder
relay.relay_note: This upstream will be converted to Responses API via local 127.0.0.1:57321, requiring Codex to be started from Codex++.
relay.tools_desc: MCP, Skills, and Plugins are managed independently as global configurations and will be merged when switching any provider.
relay.items_count: There are currently {{count}} {{label}}s; these entries are saved independently of the provider and will be written to config.toml after switching any provider.
relay.empty_items: No {{label}} yet, can be added from common config file or here.
relay.toml_placeholder:
Only fill in the content below the header, e.g.:
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp"]
relay.preview_desc_active: Preview of what will be written after switching current provider; changes in context switches reflect immediately
relay.preview_desc_inactive: Preview of what will be written when switching to this provider; changes in context switches reflect immediately
relay.common_config_desc: Only keep cross-provider configurations other than MCP, Skills, and Plugins; tools and plugins are managed on independent pages.
relay.auth_note_active: Currently in use: filled back from ~/.codex/auth.json on open, saved as this provider's auth archive
relay.auth_note_inactive: Will be written to ~/.codex/auth.json when switching to this provider
relay.compat_enhance_desc: Suitable for official login or official mixing API Key; keeps session delete, export, project move, timeline, and user scripts, disables enhancements related to plugin entry.
relay.full_enhance_desc: Suitable for pure API; enables plugin entry, forced installation, session delete/export, project move, and all page capabilities.
relay.master_switch_disabled: The master switch for provider configuration is disabled
relay.editor_status_new: New provider needs to be saved to the list first
relay.editor_status_disabled: Master switch of provider profiles is disabled; currently only saving settings without writing to Codex live files
relay.editor_status_inactive: Saved changes will be used upon next profile switch
relay.help_official_mix: This provider uses official login mode with API Key mixed in; page enhancement remains in compatible mode.
relay.help_official_normal: This provider switches back to official login mode using official ChatGPT account without writing API Key.
relay.help_pure_api: This provider writes to both config.toml and auth.json; API Key is injected into provider bearer token.
relay.switch_to_pure_api: Switched to Pure API for this provider; full page enhancement is enabled.
relay.switch_to_official_mix: Using official login with API Key mixed in for this provider; compatible page enhancement is enabled.
relay.switch_to_official: Switched back to official login for this provider; compatible page enhancement is enabled.
relay.validation_missing_config: Provider "{{name}}" is missing an independent config.toml. Switch halted to avoid showing previous configuration. Please save config.toml in the provider details first.
relay.validation_mix_api_key_auth_error: Official mix API should not save OPENAI_API_KEY in auth.json. Please clean auth.json for this provider before switching.

enhance.title: Page Enhancements
enhance.detail: Interface capabilities like session delete, export, project move, timeline, and user scripts
enhance.enable_enhance_desc: When disabled, session delete, export, project move, timeline, plugin-related, and menu placement enhancements will be deactivated.
enhance.enable_computer_use_guard_desc: Disabled by default; when enabled, the config.toml, bundled plugins, and notify configurations required by the official Computer Use plugin will be automatically preserved when starting Codex.
enhance.compat_mode_hint: Currently in compatible enhancement mode. Plugin marketplace unlock, forced entry unlock, and special plugin forced install are disabled; other page features remain available.
enhance.notice_hint: If using official mode or official mixing API mode, unlocking plugin marketplace, forcing entry unlock, and forcing special plugin installation are usually not required.

features.marketplace_unlock_desc: Extends plugin marketplace requests in API Key mode to display the full plugin list as much as possible; usually not needed in official/mixed mode.
features.entry_unlock_desc: Restores the entry unlock method of version 1.1.9, forcing the display and activation of the plugin entry point.
features.plugin_install_desc: Removes frontend installation disablement caused by 'App unavailable'.
features.whitelist_unlock_desc: Pulls models from environment variables and config.toml's /v1/models and adds them to the model list.
features.fast_btn_desc: Displays service mode switch button; Fast only supports gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.5, other models are sent as Standard.
features.session_delete_desc: Displays a delete button when hovering over the session list and supports undoing.
features.export_desc: Displays an export button in the session list, exporting Markdown with timestamps.
features.project_move_desc: Moves sessions to regular conversations or other local projects.
features.timeline_desc: Displays a user question timeline on the right side of the conversation, supporting summary and navigation.
features.center_width_desc: Limits the main conversation and input box to a fixed maximum width, suitable for large screen reading.
features.scroll_restore_desc: Restores the last scroll position when switching threads.
features.zed_open_desc: Remote SSH file references can be opened directly with Zed Remote Development.
features.zed_registry_desc: Maintains Codex++'s own list of recently opened remote projects.
features.zed_sync_desc: Advanced option, disabled by default; current implementation does not actively modify Zed settings.
features.upstream_worktree_desc: Creates a Git worktree from the latest upstream branch.
features.native_menu_desc: Inserts the Codex++ menu into Codex's top native menu bar.
